# tebib_security_group (Data Source)

Looks up a security group by ID, by name, or a VPC's default group (`default = true`, with `vpc_id`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebib_security_group" "default" {
  default = true
  vpc_id  = data.tebib_vpc.default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Look up the default security group (every project has one).
- `id` (String) security group ID.
- `name` (String) Name to look up.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Default: the provider's `project`.
- `vpc_id` (String) Only look in this VPC.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags.
- `trn` (String) TRN.
